substeps.label: B6–B7 · cool, depowder, unload
substeps.caption: Cool and de-inert, depowder gently, photograph the plate in place, then lift the four panels out. The plate only needs the powder blown out of the pocket gaps before the next run.

substeps.label: C1 · top-view images
substeps.caption: Each panel gets top-view images (are the tracks continuous, which ones balled up?). Panel A goes first, all the way through SEM, to catch problems early: track mapping, etch, SEM charging.
